content.query:
SELECT TOP 10 A.CustomerId, A.CustomerType, D.FORACID, D.GAM_ACID, D.GAM_SCHM_CODE, D.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE, D.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
FROM dw.DimCustomer_BU_20240119 A
INNER JOIN dw.DimCustomerAccount_BU_20240119 B
ON A.CustomerSK = B.CustomerSK
INNER JOIN dw.DimBank C
ON B.BankSK = C.BankSK
INNER JOIN dw.DEPOSITS_FACT D
ON B.AccountID = D.FORACID 
AND D.as_of_date BETWEEN A.ValidStartDate AND A.ValidEndDate
AND D.as_of_date BETWEEN B.ValidStartDate AND B.ValidEndDate
AND D.as_of_date BETWEEN C.ValidStartDate AND C.ValidEndDate
WHERE A.CustomerType = 'Retail'
AND B.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND B.ShareIndicator = 'Y'
AND C.BankID = 'CBC01'
AND D.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP > 10000
ORDER BY D.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE DESC
